== Usage

By title: <<Installation>>. By reftext: <<Command line>>.
With label: <<Installation,the install steps>>.
Shorthand via macro: xref:Installation[install].

Reftext hides the title: <<CLI usage>>.
Inline anchor reftext: <<Free text>>, defined by [[free,Free text]]this anchor.
Lowercase with a space: <<installation steps>>.
Lowercase without a space is an ID only: <<installation>>.
With a hash no title is matched: <<#Installation>>.
